---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Motion Studio
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that is hard or impossible today? Describe the use
case, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. If it is an editor/UI change, describe the
workflow; if it is an API/CLI change, sketch the signature or command.

## Could this be a plugin?

Motion Studio is built around the `MotionCorrector` / `MotionMetrics` plugin
contract (`docs/PLUGINS.md`). If your idea is a new correction or metric, it may
fit as a plugin without changing the core — let us know if you have tried that.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, references, or anything else.
